newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down after falls in India.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down after falls in India.

text.p: Pakistani stocks, which posted a slight gain in morning trade, ended down on Wednesday after Indian stocks took a beating, dealers said.

The Karachi 100-share index ended 8.88 points, or 0.60 percent, down at 1,475.30 after rising to 1,487.11 points in early trade. Gainers led losers 137 to 113. Volume rose to 40.56 million from Tuesday's 40.50 million.

The index fell on selling by foreign investors in Pakistani bourses after shares in Indian bourses tumbled, a dealer at Taurus Securities said. "Small investors also started selling and that dragged down the index," he added.
